wholePhysicalScope: OpenStreetMap cadastral castle outline and building-part relation, public-domain exterior reference photography already published by Qualla, and the operating château’s architectural description.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the open courtyard, distinct royal wings, staircase, chapel and retaining tower.
limitations: Mapped roof and part heights are approximate. Courtyard grades, fine sculpture and details of partially hidden elevations are interpreted. Interiors and unrelated neighboring buildings are outside the model.
